name: EquipmentRentalCheckout
tagline: Camera, grip and lighting rental desk – quotes, availability, counter checkout & check-in, damage and invoicing in one Power Platform control.
description: A complete rental-house app for film and TV kit: rule-checked order pipeline, double-booking protection per item code, insurance-certificate, deposit and prep gates, a counter view with item scanning for checkout and check-in, rental-house week billing, late fees, damage charges and invoices. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Insurance certificate threshold, deposit % and prep gates before checkout
Scan or type item codes to check kit back in
Rental-house week pricing (e.g. 3-day week), discounts, late fees, damage and tax
Invoice numbers and invoice summary text
Drag & drop, keyboard moves, bulk actions, undo and CSV export
